URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-hits-ukraines-odesa-dnipro-with-drones-missiles-overnight-officials-say-2026-05-18/
TITLE: Russian attacks kill one, injure more than 30 in Ukraine overnight, officials say
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-18 (early Monday)
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY FACTS:
- Russia launched drones, airstrikes, shelling overnight 17-18 May
- Targets: Odesa (south), Dnipro (southeast)
- 1 killed, 30+ injured

ODESA (Black Sea export port):
- Drones hit residential buildings, a school, and a kindergarten
- 11-year-old boy + 59-year-old man injured (Serhiy Lysak, local mil admin head)

DNIPRO:
- Missile attack injured 18
- Among injured: 2-year-old girl, 10-year-old boy (Oleksandr Hanzha, regional governor)

ZAPORIZHZHIA: 3 injured (Ivan Fedorov, regional governor)
KHERSON: 1 killed, 9 injured (Oleksandr Prokudin, regional governor)

RUSSIA:
- Drones downed overnight over Rostov, Belgorod (Interfax citing defence ministry)
- Both sides deny targeting civilians
